events.text: Summer sees the publication of many tomes of impressive sagecraft in the Realms, detailing some of humanity's greatest magical accomplishments. Each of these works earns the authors fame, especially Blaeruityn of Ankhapur who invents the first book capable of reading itself. Though each tome and it's author are eventually forgotten, a single copy of The Trail of Wonder by Aumtevel Dlarrin of Elembar was to become stored in Candlekeep.

The spell itself is not accounted for.

events.text: Rapid population growth of the city of Khôltar nearly bankrupts the local government by necessitating the expansion of the city's walls every few years.
